// GREEN fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the IDENTITY-relevant slice (P-ID-03 / P-024).
// The lint MUST admit this. Every S1 profile-PII / S2 real-identity column carries its
// #[personal_data(...)] tag, so the per-subject crypto-shred erase (ID-D8) and the RoPA/data-map
// fan-out reach it. Non-PII columns (`principal_id`, `region`) need no tag — they are opaque ids.
pub struct PrincipalRow {
    pub principal_id: PrincipalId,
    #[personal_data(contact)]
    pub email: String,
    #[personal_data(identity)]
    pub display_name: String,
    #[personal_data(identity)]
    pub full_name: String,
    pub region: Region,
}
